notes.title: Game Demo Version 2.0 Update is Now Live!
notes.content:
[p][b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a Shop Scene: Furniture is now acquired by refreshing booths within the scene. The previous furniture-selling function by the shopkeeper has been removed; she now only provides material purchases.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Beginner Quests to help players quickly grasp gameplay mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]Added shortcut keys for switching between certain interfaces.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Optimizations[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enhanced UI animations and transition effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved highlighting and selection feedback for interactive objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support to deselect furniture by clicking empty spaces.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized character work animations and crafting timers.[/p][/*][*][p]Refined sound effect playback, resolving issues with overlapping sounds and audio clipping.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed interaction issues including furniture clipping errors and placement abnormalities.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed multiple underlying bugs such as glitches in farming and fishing animations.[/p][/*][/list][p]"whimsy bake&craft" is coming soon!
Thank you for supporting our game![/p]
